outcome.technical: One run-time record, no second deriver. _evidence_io.py gains the follower protocol in one home: FOLLOWER_MARK, follower_line(path, recipe, owner, needs_browser) (the line a step prints: `FOLLOWER-OWED <json>`), followers_in(text) -> (records, unread), and row_for writes `followersOwed: [{path, recipe, owner[, needsBrowser]}]` (path and recipe through redacted_paths, cut at MAX_PATHS) plus `followersUnread` when a marked line did not parse; both only when non-empty. run-test-gate.run_gate reads every step's text through followers_in and returns followersOwed/followersUnread. Owners wired through the structured line, never their prose: _deps gains MAP_RECIPE (`python3 plugins/audit/scripts/_deps.py --write-map`), map_follower() (a record only for the stale-fence drift, compared to the module's own _MAP_STALE constant; map_drift now takes script_dir/layers for fixtures), write_map() and a `--write-map` CLI flag (`--render` only prints, so it could not be a recipe); test__deps g1 prints the line when the map is stale. _refs gains pin_followers(drift) (one record per document with a finding at a line, recipe None = hand-edited); test__refs p1 prints it. tools/check-rendered-artifacts.arm_verdict prints a follower line under each STALE artifact with refresh_for(rel) as the recipe. drive-phase: on a red task gate, follow_red_gate (once per start) reads the row via the gate's `evidence: recorded <runId>` line, widens the task's files with every follower path (audit-task scope, an audit-task note `files widened by <paths>: owed by <owner> on run <runId>` as the basis, accept_scope so no scope-changed decision), runs each generated recipe in the task's tree (tree or gitRoot, 600s bound, a failing recipe is a stop), and gates again; a needsBrowser recipe is printed as one `follow <task>: run `<recipe>` in <tree>, then next <phase>` instruction and never run; a hand-edited follower (recipe None) is widened and the red stands as gate-red, so after the hand edit the integration has no undeclared path. PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md: the module-map paragraph now names --write-map and the follower path; the map itself is unchanged (no import edge added: _deps --write-map on the guide is byte-identical, cmp exit 0). Tests: test_run_test_gate fo-block (2 tests.add cases + fow1 no-follower/unread twin), test_drive_phase fw-block (generated follower case + fw2 needsBrowser never run) and fh-block (hand-edited wave case), test__deps g8/g9, test__refs p1a. Mutations in scratch copies, __pycache__ purged: follow_red_gate ignoring owed -> fw, fw2, fh red (0/3); browser recipe run anyway -> fw2 red; run_gate not collecting -> both run-test-gate tests.add cases red; row_for writing an empty followersOwed -> fow1 red; map_follower firing on any drift -> g8 red; pin_followers without the line>0 filter -> p1a red; write_map not writing -> g9 red. Real emission seen in a scratch copy with a one-edge-stale guide: test__deps printed `FOLLOWER-OWED {"owner": "_deps.map_drift", "path": "PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md", "recipe": "python3 plugins/audit/scripts/_deps.py --write-map"}`, and after `_deps.py --write-map` g1 passed. Runs: full sweep `python3 tools/sweep-selftests.py --quiet` exit 0, 335/335 files ok, 16217 cases; ruff `All checks passed!`; vermin no violations; tools/gate-parity.py green; tools/check-rendered-artifacts.py --before-commit OK. Line delta scripts+hooks: `git diff --numstat -- plugins/audit/scripts plugins/audit/hooks` = +218/-8 (net +210; `find plugins/audit/scripts plugins/audit/hooks -name '*.py' -exec cat {} + | wc -l` 157227 at base -> 157437); D9's 3.4.0 count could not be compared: `git show v3.4.0` fails, no such tag in this clone. Process note: the usage line of _deps.py's CLI was edited with `sed -i`, not the Edit tool - one line, now `usage: _deps.py --selftest | --render | --write-map | --contracts`. Limits left open: (1) a follower an executor hand-edits BEFORE any red gate has no record (the lint is green by then), so it still reaches undeclared-change in a wave; the record exists only when a gate went red. (2) examples/report.sh also rewrites docs/index.html, which is not recorded as a follower, so a regenerated report would leave that path undeclared. (3) screenshots are not wired: no emitter in tools/capture-screenshots.mjs (not in files); the needsBrowser path is built and tested with a fixture recipe. (4) a reused (repeated) red verdict row carries no followersOwed, so the drive falls back to gate-red there.
